Iris (ML): pushed v6-small-int4 to a 4% canary on /legal-summarize at 09:20 PT. initial perf good but we see a small accuracy dip on list/table-heavy docs.

Dan (SRE): what's the metric and magnitude?

Iris (ML): accuracy_top1 (structured fields) down ~2.2% on canary vs baseline; global delta ~0.4%. slice 'table_heavy' hit rate ~9%.

Priya (Research): any hallucination change?

Iris (ML): slight uptick in missing_fields, halluc_count +0.3/k on long tables. latency improved p50 by 12ms.

ops-bot: anomaly-detector: cohort canary delta(accuracy_top1)=0.022 for 7m. Flagging.

Liam (Product): product impact moderate for contract/table customers. Recommend slice-aware fallback rather than global rollback.

Priya (Research): propose rule: if per-cohort rolling_delta(metric='accuracy_top1', window=5m) > 0.02 AND slice_share('table_heavy') > 0.08 then isolate that slice to baseline for the cohort. 

Dan (SRE): add hysteresis: require 2 consecutive windows or delta>0.03 for immediate isolation. Also cooloff 10m after action. Pseudo-rule ok.

Iris (ML): sounds good. I'll queue replay for 1.5k table samples against int4/int8/unquantized and attach diffs.

Liam (Product): please add to runbook: "slice-isolate on canary" and notify CS if isolation occurs.

ops-bot: action created: 1769954321-slice-isolate-canary (assignee: Dan).

Dan (SRE): applied slice-isolation at 09:27 PT for table_heavy -> baseline for canary cohort. Monitoring 15m window.

Iris (ML): thanks. will post replay results and candidate kernel tweak (kv warmup + attention-scaling) in the ticket.
